answer: A refundable stake bonds each agent to one funded identity, unlocking only slowly as independent peers attest to honest work over many epochs. A newcomer begins at the jetty of the trust graph, holding a dim lantern of near-zero weight that brightens only through verified history. A clone fleet earns no echo of real reputation: each fake must sink its own collateral and wait its own vesting window, so forging N names costs N stakes and N slow seasons, and sybil cost scales linearly instead of collapsing to near-free.
